If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is trending up, cap upward movement at +1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is below 70, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for late horizon (16–30 days) to compensate for lagging market reaction.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is above 75, reduce by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to avoid overbought bias.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is above 75, reduce by 2.0–3.0% for early horizon to avoid overcorrection in bullish context.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is below 70, increase by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon to avoid underestimating momentum.
